# Clinician Attestation & Governance Specification

**Document**: `docs/CLINICIAN_ATTESTATION.md`  
**Milestone**: Phase 7 — Deterministic Clinical Reporting & Clinician Attestation  
**Author**: Healthcare Compliance Architect & Enterprise Security Lead  

---

## 1. Clinical Review Mandate

Under healthcare regulatory frameworks (including HIPAA, FDA Clinical Decision Support guidance, and Joint Commission standards), an AI system is an administrative and diagnostic assistant, not a licensed practitioner. 

**Core Principle**: No clinical report generated by Companio may automatically enter the permanent medical record without explicit, authenticated review and attestation by a licensed clinician.

---

## 2. Attestation Model (`ReportAttestation.js`)

Each attestation event creates a tamper-evident record:

| Field | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `organizationId` | ObjectId | Scoped healthcare tenant identifier |
| `reportId` | ObjectId | Target report document reference |
| `reportVersion` | Number | Exact version number being attested |
| `clinicianUserId` | ObjectId | User account of the reviewing clinician |
| `membershipId` | ObjectId | Multi-tenant organization membership reference |
| `attestationStatement`| String | Standardized or custom clinical sign-off statement |
| `statementVersion` | String | Version of the attestation policy statement (`1.0`) |
| `reportContentHash` | String | SHA-256 digest of the canonical report payload |
| `approvedAt` | Date | Wall-clock timestamp of clinical sign-off |
| `authenticationContext`| Object | IP address, User-Agent, request ID, auth method |
| `status` | String | `ACTIVE`, `SUPERSEDED`, or `REVOKED` |

---

## 3. Mandatory Attestation Statement

Default statement presented in the Clinician Workspace:

> *"I have reviewed this report and its available supporting patient information. My approval represents my clinical review of this document."*

---

## 4. Verification Workflow

1. **Review**: Clinician opens report in `PatientDetail.jsx` or `ClinicianDashboard.jsx`.
2. **Preview**: Clinician clicks "Review & Attest". The backend checks organization tenancy and computes the current SHA-256 hash.
3. **Attestation Submission**: Clinician confirms the attestation statement.
4. **Immutability Enforcement**: The report status transitions to `APPROVED`, locking all fields. Any subsequent modification must go through the formal `POST /api/v1/reports/:id/amend` route.
